needChanges: Need a server or password changed? Your administrator can switch protunel to Full mode under Settings › General.

chooser.subtitle: How will you use it?
chooser.simpleTagline: Open internal sites with one switch
chooser.simpleDetail: Your administrator sets up the servers and sends you a config file. You turn the internal network on and browse; nothing else to configure.
chooser.fullDetail: Create and edit tunnels, port forwards and router rules, open SSH terminals, route single apps.
chooser.footer: Change any time in Settings › General
